sites.downstream: returned category label string from simple_classify()
sites.reason: Closed-set classification over 10 enumerated insurance categories. Short text input from curated data files. No math, date comparison, multi-hop reasoning, generation, or adversarial input. Textbook Choice primitive.

options.benefit: Likely cheaper per accepted decision ($0.042/Mtok input-only vs Haiku pricing); faster for high-confidence decisions where Jev accepts without needing the original model.
options.risk: Serial miss adds Jev latency and cost before original inference. Expected cost = Jev cost + fallback_fraction x original cost.

options.benefit: Removes original model cost entirely after proven parity.
options.risk: Excluded by conservative risk posture. Requires measured parity evidence.
